name: dsh-local-no-auth
description: DSH plugin: skip the per-restart ?token= browser gate for loopback-only Web GUI deployments. Prints and opens a clean URL, serves / and /api without a token — but ONLY while the webserver is bound to 127.0.0.1 AND the request's Host header is a loopback name; anything else falls back to the stock token/cookie authentication. The connection Host/Origin fence (isTrustedApiRequest) is left untouched.
